author: TMRX
description: Configure a product from the Price List catalog, generate a customer quote, push parts to a Work Order, or start a Rental.
versionDescription: Two fixes to the Rental tab following v3.27.0: (1) Account/Contact/Ship To were missing from the Rental Contract because they were wrongly modeled as per-unit fields — moved them into the shared RentalDetailsBox (one customer per rental batch, same assumption the contract makes). Picking a Contact before an Account now auto-derives both Account and Ship To from that contact's own Company record — 'just pick the contact and it populates everything.' (2) Cleaning and Calibration now defaults to waived on every new line — the fee is already baked into the rental price schedule, so showing the standard EUR2,000 price noted as waived is a deliberate customer-facing gesture, not an actual discount. Still an editable checkbox to actually charge it in the rare case that's needed.
